question: Can a separate bounded stationary V50 session settle the completed upright recovery when whole-system horizontal COM speed alone prevents fresh V56 walking entry?

entry_decision.source: Original complete native recovery receipt plus independently projected same-step readiness source packet.
entry_decision.already_ready: Preserve immediate fresh V56 entry with zero post-recovery hold commands.
entry_decision.other_unready_outcomes: Retain a bounded development negative; do not broaden the hold to partial, prone, unsupported, tilted, geometrically infeasible or angularly unsettled entries.

hold.frame_selection: Existing V50 hold frame helper with empty development frame selection; frame is frozen at current native torso pose.
hold.memory: Fresh native V50 session only; no ramp, prefix, completed-recovery or earlier walking memory transplant.
hold.sampling: One fresh same-step complete readiness source after every hold command; count only complete consecutive all-five-ready samples and reset the dwell on every non-ready sample.
hold.readiness_predicate: Unchanged R10S all-five walking-entry predicate; whole-system native COM speed <= 0.03 m/s, torso angular speed <= 0.15 rad/s, tilt <= 0.05 rad, four native supports and all zero-bias reference paths feasible.
hold.boundary_order: A 30th consecutive ready sample at command 240 succeeds. Otherwise command 240 closes a negative. Command 241 is forbidden.
hold.finalization: Finalize the distinct hold session exactly once, retain the final source and memory, release its actuation ownership and start a separate fresh V56 walking session on the next command.
hold.timeout: Close and retain post_recovery_hold_timeout; no fresh V56 start, recovery retry, budget extension or replayed physical continuation.
hold.intervention_caveat: Zero commanded planar motion does not mean fixed joint targets: on the frozen phase-245 pose, V50 targets reach 0.5450643393535838 rad from the measured pose, with maximum command-to-command change 0.029166666666671226 rad. This is bounded native posture control, not a prediction of settling.

limits.wall_basis: The physical horizon gains at most 240 commands. The child wall ceiling gains a bounded 240 seconds over R10S; this changes no solver timing, controller threshold or physical result criterion.

preserved: Unchanged R10R upright V20-support/V12-rise/V7-stance native composition and 60-sample completion.
Unchanged partial and canonical prone recovery policies, branch observations and task thresholds.
Unchanged V56 360-command preparation, four planned cycles, forward threshold, full walking envelope and complete 120-command stop.
Unchanged no-kick ramp followed by its original separate V50 hold.
Original kick energy epoch, same body identities, native contacts, motor caps and per-command telemetry; no reset or transform/velocity write.
All R10S physical and zero-world records, source keys, outcomes and consumed identities.
retention: Bind the initial readiness decision to the original terminal native recovery event before selecting hold or direct entry.
Retain every hold request, exact native response, host transport check, motor application receipt, collection source, readiness sample and orchestrator transition.
Keep hold commands and counters separate from recovery, walking cycles and stop. All physical steps still count in global and kick-epoch totals.
Independently replay the conditional decision, fresh session ownership, every hold command and sample, dwell reset, exact timeout/finalization, and fresh V56 handoff.
A failed hold is a retained negative with a complete physical trace, not missing or discarded evidence.

required_zero_world_checks: Actual DLL and facade selection, fresh session and zero-command controls, missing/crossed state, floor, runtime and memory refusals.
Same-step source binding and original terminal memory preservation; direct-ready bypass and speed-only upright eligibility; all other unready outcomes refuse.
Dwell reset, readiness at command 30, command 240 success and timeout, command 241 refusal, nonfinite/crossed/stale samples and no stepping terminal states.
Complete orchestrator clocks, energy epoch, ownership, fresh hold and fresh V56 memory, no hold commands counted as walking and no duplicated finalization.
Production launcher, candidate selection, real adapter, reader, full report retention, publication and negative controls.
Preserved no-kick, ready upright, partial and prone timelines on copied retained input with no physical reclassification.

first_diagnostic.coverage: Exposed difficult handoff, fresh hold motor ownership, readiness release, fresh V56, all four cycles and full stop.

development_coverage.if_first_not_valid_positive: Close the R10T development chain and retain its result. No pair or later R10T physical diagnostic may launch.

after_first_valid_positive.if_pair_not_valid_positive: Close the R10T development chain. No later R10T physical diagnostic may launch.
after_first_valid_positive.additional_coverage_adequacy: These three single-role diagnostics cover distinct complete terminal-memory producers and finalization paths through the new route/reader. Phase 246 explicitly covers ready upright bypass; partial and prone remain separate native histories. They are not extra tuning seeds or matched comparisons. The no-kick population is fresh only in the pair.
after_first_valid_positive.additional_negative_rule: Retain every result once. Remaining predeclared branch diagnostics may complete for coverage; any negative prevents a held-out declaration under this design.

development_coverage.held_out_precondition: All declared fresh development roles must be valid finite positives, with hold used only where required and all direct paths bypassing it. A separate prospective held-out contract and complete qualification are still required.
